caption: An undefeated World Heavyweight Champion whose 8-0 reign and unbeaten streak both ended the same night, to a longtime rival.

name: "Playboy" Ronnie D
notes: Known from one in-character press item posted to rec.sport.pro-wrestling.fantasy on 3 January 1998, titled "THE WAIT IS OVER! "Playboy" Ronnie D signs with NOW! A "Playboy" RP for you!", served at /promotions/rspwf/archive/the-wait-is-over-playboy-ronnie-d-signs-with-now-a-playboy-rp-for-you-1998-01-03.html. It reports that on 2 January 1998, before the main event of NOW Survival of the Beast 2 (where "Chaotic" Christopher Childress beat Christopher Stonebreaker for the NOW World Title), Ronnie D came out to "I'm Too Sexy" with a throng of women, announced that he had dumped the NeCW and signed with Network Online Wrestling, and boasted to a booing crowd that he is the icon and the god of e-wrestling; his debut is set for 10 January against "Blazer" Barry Blades. The handler's signature gives the character as #32 in the 1997 RSPWF 200.
caption: The self-styled icon and god of e-wrestling, who walks out with seven women to announce his NOW signing in January 1998.

tenures.source: /promotions/rspwf/archive/the-wait-is-over-playboy-ronnie-d-signs-with-now-a-playboy-rp-for-you-1998-01-03.html (the e-Wrestling Press item of 3 January 1998 reporting his NOW signing on 2 January and his coming debut on 10 January)
